name: 小电企鹅
habitatEn: Commonly found in the Snowy Mountains
evolution: 小电企鹅 → 电企鹅 Lv.32
description: 它们生活在寒冷的水域，会用头顶的晶体吸收空气里的电能量。当能量充足时，晶体表面会浮现细碎的亮纹和电光。偏爱暴雪与打雷的天气，风雪越大、雷声越近，它们越活跃。
descriptionEn: They live in cold waters and use the crystal on their head to absorb electrical energy from the air. When energy is plentiful, fine bright patterns and electric light appear on the crystal's surface. They prefer blizzards and thunderstorms; the heavier the snow and the closer the thunder, the more active they become.

skills.name: 风吹雪
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; restores 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 超导加速
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己获得速度+30。

skills.name: 聒噪
skills.description: 敌方获得全攻击技能能耗+2，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains +2 energy cost to all attack skills for 3 turns.

skills.name: 寒风吹
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得魔防-50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; enemy gains Magic Defense -50%.

skills.name: 电流
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 冰锋横扫
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能威力等于敌方精灵技能总能耗的10倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; this skill's power equals 10 times the enemy's total skill energy cost.

skills.name: 感电
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每离场1次，本技能使用次数永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; each time it leaves the field, this skill's uses permanently +1.

skills.name: 雾气环绕
skills.description: 回复能量，回复值等于敌方技能总能耗的一半。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores energy equal to half of the enemy's total skill energy cost.

skills.name: 落雷
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次入场，本技能威力永久+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; each time it enters the field, this skill's power permanently +40.

skills.name: 极寒领域
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若敌方有冻结，本次技能威力+60，应对状态：使冻结翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if the enemy is frozen, this skill's power +60; when responding to a status: doubles the freeze.
